rationale: The global live game starts as a different preview snapshot on reload, and save() uses display state rather than normal-run provenance. A title explanation can trigger persistence of that unrelated board. This loses a resumable deal and its existing run identity. Browser checks should confirm both reload and explicit Portal paths before and after narrowing the save boundary.

actual_next_action.description: Reproduced original save overwrite using native new deal/draw/reload/title explanation then reload and Portal. Applied root-authorized narrow provenance guard. Four fixed regressions include restored normal explanations, and all preserve seed/UUID/position/history. Additional independent model simulation, typecheck, build and four-viewport full native fixture clear validate surrounding behavior.
